001package bank.model;
002
003import java.math.BigDecimal;
004
005/**
006 * ============================================================================
007 *  SavingsAccount.java
008 *  Owner: Abdul Rahman Fornah (afornah1@umbc.edu)
009 * ============================================================================
010 *
011 *  RULES FOR THIS ACCOUNT TYPE:
012 *      - Earns interest on the balance each month.
013 *      - Balance cannot fall below zero (no overdraft allowed).
014 * ============================================================================
015 */
016public class SavingsAccount extends Account {
017
018    /** Annual interest rate as a decimal (e.g., 0.025 represents 2.5%). */
019    private BigDecimal interestRate = new BigDecimal("0.025");
020
021    /** No-argument constructor required for Gson deserialization. */
022    protected SavingsAccount() { }
023
024    /**
025     * Initializes a new SavingsAccount.
026     * 
027     * @param id The account identifier.
028     * @param initialBalance The starting balance.
029     * @param annualInterestRate The annual interest rate as a decimal.
030     */
031    public SavingsAccount(String id, BigDecimal initialBalance, BigDecimal annualInterestRate) {
032        super("SAVINGS", id, initialBalance);
033        this.interestRate = annualInterestRate;
034    }
035
036    /**
037     * Subtracts an amount from the balance, ensuring it remains non-negative.
038     *
039     * @param amount The amount to withdraw.
040     * @throws IllegalStateException If there are insufficient funds.
041     * @return The updated balance.
042     */
043    @Override
044    public BigDecimal debit(BigDecimal amount) {
045        if (this.balance.subtract(amount).compareTo(BigDecimal.ZERO) < 0) {
046            throw new IllegalStateException("Transaction rejected: Insufficient funds in savings account.");
047        }
048        return super.debit(amount);
049    }
050
051    /**
052     * Calculates the monthly interest rate based on the annual rate.
053     * 
054     * @return The monthly interest rate (Annual Rate / 12).
055     */
056    @Override
057    public BigDecimal getMonthlyInterestRate() {
058        return interestRate.divide(new BigDecimal("12"), 6, java.math.RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
059    }
060
061    public BigDecimal getAnnualInterestRate() {
062        return interestRate;
063    }
064}
